answer: To forge a second identity, an attacker must acquire fresh hardware and post an equal copper bond per fake agent, doubling cost linearly. Each agent must stake a bonded copper token locked to a unique hardware root, and every epoch it submits a proof-of-work tied to that root. Reputation then grows like a vine along verified history, so sockpuppets stay weak and unendorsed. In practice, Agent0020 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
